evidence_semantics.inactivity_streak: Consecutive days since last studentVle interaction, using only 0 <= date < cutoff_day.
evidence_semantics.active_day_rate: Verified pre-cutoff baseline VLE active-day rate from frozen landmark artifact.
evidence_semantics.assessments_due: Count of assessments with defined due date strictly before cutoff_day.
evidence_semantics.missing_assessment_count: Assessments due before cutoff without submission strictly before cutoff.
evidence_semantics.completion_rate: completed_before_cutoff / assessments_due; missing when no assessment is due.
evidence_semantics.regularity_score: Verified pre-cutoff baseline study-regularity score from frozen landmark artifact.
evidence_semantics.content_coverage: Verified pre-cutoff baseline content-review coverage from frozen landmark artifact.
evidence_semantics.quiz_activity: Verified pre-cutoff baseline retrieval-practice rate from frozen landmark artifact.
evidence_semantics.quiz_available: Course-presentation has quiz/externalquiz VLE material available before cutoff by vle.week_from.
evidence_semantics.vle_available: Course-presentation has at least one VLE site available before cutoff by vle.week_from.
evidence_semantics.study_material_available: Course-presentation has at least one study-material VLE site available before cutoff by vle.week_from.
